command.updateVersion: Mettre à jour la version de la dépendance
command.updateAllVersions: Mettre à jour toutes les dépendances
command.showUpToDate: Afficher l'état de mise à jour du paquet
config.title: Mise à jour des dépendances npm
config.showPrerelease.description: Inclure les versions pré-release dans les suggestions
config.cacheTTLMinutes.description: Durée du cache TTL pour les données de version npm (minutes)
config.checkVulnerabilities.description: Vérifier les versions exactes sur OSV.dev pour les vulnérabilités connues
config.strategy.description: Update target: latest release, same maintenance line (compatible; 0.x stays within its minor), or same major.minor (patch). This is not a compatibility guarantee.
config.minimumReleaseAgeDays.description: Minimum release age in days. 0 disables the delay. When enabled, releases without timestamps are excluded. Known-vulnerability fixes follow the same policy; reduce the delay explicitly when needed.
config.ignoredVersions.description: Exact versions to ignore by package name, e.g. {"example": ["2.0.0"]}.
config.deferredPackages.description: Defer packages until an ISO 8601 date/time, e.g. {"example": "2027-01-01T00:00:00Z"}.
config.targetNodeVersion.description: Concrete target Node version. When empty, read .nvmrc or .node-version. If no concrete version is available, runtime compatibility is unknown.
config.validationCommands.description: Project checks to run in an isolated copy, as executable/args objects (no shell). Empty uses available test, typecheck and build scripts. Commands execute only when you choose Preview and Validate in a trusted workspace.
config.allowInstallScripts.description: Allow package lifecycle scripts during isolated npm/pnpm/Yarn Classic/Bun installation. Disabled by default; enable only for a trusted project that requires them.
